definitions: Used to refer to a thing previously mentioned or easily identified.
Used to refer to an animal or child of unspecified sex.
Used as the subject of an impersonal verb or statement referring to a general fact.
Used to refer to a situation or to a preceding clause or statement.
Used as a dummy subject or object.
Used to emphasize a particular part of a sentence.
examples: She picked up the book and opened it.
The baby was crying; it wanted its mother.
It's a shame that you can't come.
I find it difficult to believe.
